description: SLICE C (downstream layer): generalize arg_demands_for_summary's multi-target argument FLOOR to closure calls. The existing special case floors argument index 0 to Whole for multi-target callsites (fz-bin.5, protocol-dispatch receivers; runtime_demand.rs ~2384-2401) but is not generalized to CallInputMode::Closure or to non-receiver argument positions. When a closure callsite has summary.targets.len() > 1, floor EVERY argument to Whole -- because the physical boxed-apply ABI (CallEdge::Indirect/generic_callable_shape, fz-k22.1/.2) must transmit a real value in every lane regardless of what any resolved callee does with it, so a discarded-_acc join of Ignore-v-Ignore must NOT starve the accumulator's materialization. This fix is PROVEN correct on the minimal find+find_value repro (progresses past the ValueId(6) demand crash to fz-k22.4's assertion). BLOCKED BY fz-k22.7: it only triggers once CallSiteSummary.targets correctly reports 2+ targets (today it under-counts to 1 for some sharings, so the multi-target floor never fires). Once fz-k22.7 lands, re-apply and land this. Related: fz-k22.7, fz-k22.1, fz-k22.2.

comments.text: PREREQUISITE-COUPLED (from .1 audit): once this slice's demand fix lets control REACH the ambiguous ClosureCall at runtime, the interp path (ir_interp/backend.rs ~765) will hard-error on function:None boxed callables -- it needs a real multi-target boxed-dispatch unpack (native already handles it via direct_callable_lanes). Tracked as fz-k22.6; turning enum_predicate_search green requires BOTH this demand fix AND that interp unpack. Also decide whether to cross-validate CallEdge::Indirect (.1) with the transport-shape function:None signal (they agree by construction but aren't checked).

UNBLOCKED (spike disproved fz-k22.7's settle-race premise). The arg-floor fix is PROVEN INDEPENDENT: the spike prototyped generalizing arg_demands_for_summary's multi-target argument floor to CallInputMode::Closure with targets.len()>1, and it took find+find_value PAST the demand crash into fz-k22.4's codegen assertion, with lib 1277/0 unchanged and no enum-subset regression. Land this fix on its own. Spike WIP for reference: commit 7c667e4ad on branch wt/spike-k22-holistic.

title: fz-k22 Slice C: runtime-demand fixpoint under-approximates a shared HOF body's UNRELATED input to Nothing when its closure-call site has 2+ distinct targets (proximate crash cause)
